dialogue.content: (こんにちは。カウンセラー役です。待機しております）
dialogue.English: (Hello. I'm playing the role of the counselor. I'm standing by.)

dialogue.content: （相談者さんは、準備できておりますでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (Is the client ready?)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.English: Hello. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: おそくなりました
dialogue.English: Sorry I'm late.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: I look forward to this as well.

dialogue.content: （はい、よろしくおねがいします。では早速始めますね）
dialogue.English: (Yes, thank you. Let's get started.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。まずはじめに差し支えなければ年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I’m the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, if you don’t mind, could you tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 30代、じょせいです
dialogue.English: I’m in my 30s, and I'm a woman.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。ちなみに相談者様を何とお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. By the way, how would you like me to address you?

dialogue.content: めぐみです
dialogue.English: I'm Megumi.

dialogue.content: めぐみさん、ですね。よろしくおねがいします。今日のご相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Megumi, is that right? It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 派遣社員なのですが、職場の上司にセクハラをうけています
dialogue.English: I'm a temporary employee, and I'm being sexually harassed by my supervisor at work.

dialogue.content: セクハラを！それはとても腹立たしく、つらいですね。
dialogue.English: Sexual harassment! That must be very frustrating and painful for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からですか？
dialogue.English: When did this start?

dialogue.content: 今までも言葉ではなんとなく嫌な雰囲気があったのですが、緊急事態宣言になって出勤３０％が決まってから、シフトを二人で入るようにされてしまったんです
dialogue.English: There had always been a somewhat unpleasant atmosphere with his words, but ever since the state of emergency was declared and our office attendance was limited to 30%, he started scheduling our shifts so that it would just be the two of us.

dialogue.content: それは、去年の緊急事態宣言からということですか？思い出すのも嫌なことだと思いますが、少しずつ状況聞かせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: So, this has been happening since the state of emergency was declared last year? I know it must be unpleasant to recall, but please tell me about the situation bit by bit.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 全く二人きりではないので
dialogue.English: It’s not completely just the two of us, though.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ただ、事務室にいるのは二人だけで、奥の作業所に職人さんが何人かいて、その人たちが出入りしてこない時間は二人になってしまうのです。
dialogue.English: It's just that there are only two of us in the office, and there are a few craftsmen in the workshop in the back. During the times they aren't coming and going, it ends up being just the two of us.

dialogue.content: かわいいよね
dialogue.English: 'You're cute.'

dialogue.content: とか
dialogue.English: and things like that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 髪の毛がきれいとか
dialogue.English: Or 'Your hair is beautiful.'

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: 向こうもそれなりにセクハラの知識もあるので
dialogue.English: He seems to have some knowledge of what constitutes sexual harassment, so...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ぎりぎりな感じの会話ですが、べたべたした感じがわかるんです
dialogue.English: The conversations are borderline, but I can sense a clingy, creepy undertone.

dialogue.content: なんだか巧みな上司ですね。まとわりつくような言葉がで、とてもめぐみさんの嫌悪感が伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: He sounds like a rather crafty supervisor. The way his words cling to you really conveys your disgust, Megumi.

dialogue.content: はい、気持ち悪くて
dialogue.English: Yes, it's disgusting.

dialogue.content: ということは一年近くも、職人さんが留守のときを見計らって言葉によるセクハラが続いているということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So does that mean that for nearly a year, he’s been timing his verbal sexual harassment for when the craftsmen are away?

dialogue.content: 本当に気持ちが悪いですよね。私まで背中がゾワゾワしてきます。
dialogue.English: That's truly disgusting. It gives me the chills just hearing about it.

dialogue.content: だけど、はっきり文句みたいに言って「わかっているじゃない」って感じになりたくないし、
dialogue.English: But I don't want to complain outright and have it turn into a situation where he's like, "So you knew what I was getting at, didn't you?"

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 書類や仕事を褒めるみたいにして、
dialogue.English: He'll pretend to compliment my documents or my work,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 電話で話す声がいいね
dialogue.English: 'You have a nice voice on the phone,'

dialogue.content: とか
dialogue.English: and things like that.

dialogue.content: 一見仕事をほめてるんですけど
dialogue.English: At first glance, it seems like he's praising my work, but...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 気持ちが悪い意図があるって感じるんです
dialogue.English: I feel there’s a creepy intention behind it.

dialogue.content: でも、仕事はやめるわけにいかないし
dialogue.English: But I can't just quit my job.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: そうですよね、生活がありますものね。
dialogue.English: Of course, you have your livelihood to consider.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナもあるから、思い切ったことできないし
dialogue.English: And with COVID, I can't make any drastic moves.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 転職とか言ってみつからなさそうだから
dialogue.English: If I tried to change jobs, I don't think I'd find anything.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・このご時世で転職は確かにご不安ですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand... Changing jobs in this climate must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.content: がまんするしかないんでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do I just have to put up with it?

dialogue.content: 我慢することはないと思います。どうしていったらいいのか一緒に考えていきたいとおもいます。さっきめぐみさんの言葉の中で、はっきり文句みたいに言って「わかっているじゃない」って感じになりたくないというお言葉があったのですが、今ひとつ私がそのあたりの意味がうまく捉えられていないので教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I don't think you should have to put up with it. I'd like for us to think together about the best way forward. A moment ago, you said that you didn't want to complain outright and have it turn into a situation where he's like, "So you knew all along." I'm not sure I fully grasp what you mean by that, so could you explain it to me?

dialogue.content: 上司が好意を持っているってわかっていないようなふりで、にげているので
dialogue.English: Because I've been avoiding it by pretending not to realize that my supervisor is interested in me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 曖昧な言い方をされているのに、「髪の毛キレイ」とか言わないでくださいとか、はっきり返すと、僕の好意はわかっているんだよねみたいな流れになりそうで
dialogue.English: His comments are ambiguous, so if I respond directly with something like, 'Please don’t say my hair is beautiful,' I'm afraid it will turn into a conversation like, 'So you do realize I have feelings for you, right?'

dialogue.content: 教えていただいて、ありがとうございます。ぼくが好意を持っているって君は気づいているじゃないのってなりたくないわけですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for explaining. So you don't want it to become a situation where he can say, "So you've known I have feelings for you all along, haven't you?"

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まだ、触るとか二人で外出とかには進んでいないので
dialogue.English: It hasn't escalated to him touching me or asking me to go out with him alone yet.

dialogue.content: でも、めぐみさんとしてはそういう言葉も気持ち悪いから辞めてほしいんですよね？
dialogue.English: But for you, Megumi, even those words are disgusting, and you want him to stop, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。前後してしまいました。めぐみさんの言葉を続けてください。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I got ahead of myself. Please continue with what you were saying.

dialogue.content: こんな程度の事はみんな我慢しているのかなって
dialogue.English: I wonder if everyone else just puts up with this kind of thing.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: シフトで同僚とは会っていない日が続いていて
dialogue.English: Because of the shifts, there have been many days when I don’t see my coworkers,

dialogue.content: 雰囲気をわかってもらえないし
dialogue.English: so they can’t really grasp the atmosphere,

dialogue.content: そうか・・それを同僚にも相談できない状況なのですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see... So you're in a situation where you can't even talk to your coworkers about it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話すと思ったよりおおごとになるのもいやで
dialogue.English: And I'm worried that if I talk about it, it will become a bigger deal than I want,

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: I understand,

dialogue.content: 同僚に話してもいいんだけど
dialogue.English: I mean, I could talk to my coworkers, but...

dialogue.content: まよいます
dialogue.English: I'm hesitant.

dialogue.content: 今は一人でその気持を抱えておられて本当にお辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be very difficult for you to be carrying these feelings all by yourself right now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: めぐみさんとしては一番どういう状況になってほしいですか？
dialogue.English: What would be the ideal situation for you, Megumi?

dialogue.content: 仕事はやめられないので
dialogue.English: Since I can't quit my job,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 上司と違うシフトに入れるのがベストです
dialogue.English: the best thing would be to be put on a different shift from my supervisor.

dialogue.content: 最悪、上司と一緒でも
dialogue.English: At worst, even if I’m on the same shift as him,

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: セクハラ発言しなければまだましかも
dialogue.English: it would be more bearable if he just didn’t make the sexually harassing remarks.

dialogue.content: でも一回こういうイメージになっちゃうと
dialogue.English: But once you get this kind of impression of someone,

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 正直いやなんですけど
dialogue.English: honestly, the thought is unpleasant.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。顔を見ると色々今までの気持ち悪い感情が思い出されてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Seeing his face must bring back all of those disgusting feelings you've had until now.

dialogue.content: でも、シフト作るのは上司なので、
dialogue.English: But he's the one who makes the schedule, so...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私たちの希望日を提出するとそこに合わせてくるんです
dialogue.English: when we submit our preferred days, he adjusts the schedule to match his shifts with mine.

dialogue.content: うわ~あからさまですね。
dialogue.English: Wow, that's so blatant.

dialogue.content: 全体で事務は7人なので
dialogue.English: There are seven of us on the admin staff in total,

dialogue.content: どうしても２・２・３みたいな
dialogue.English: so the shifts inevitably end up in combinations like 2-2-3,

dialogue.content: 組み合わせが固定しちゃって
dialogue.English: and the pairings have become fixed.

dialogue.content: みんなが感じるほどの違和感もなくて
dialogue.English: so it's not strange enough for everyone else to notice.

dialogue.content: あぁ。そういうことなんですね・・
dialogue.English: Ah, so that's what's happening...

dialogue.content: 私だけ気持ち悪い思いしてる感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like I’m the only one who is disgusted by this.

dialogue.content: それは、きつい・・・
dialogue.English: That must be tough...

dialogue.content: セクハラ上司の上司はいるんですか？
dialogue.English: Does this harassing supervisor have their own superior?

dialogue.content: 別の事務所に統括がいます
dialogue.English: There's a general manager at a different office.

dialogue.content: 別の事務所なんですね。様子は見られない状態。
dialogue.English: In another office, I see. So they're not in a position to observe what's happening.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 統括に相談しようと思ったらできそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you would be able to consult with the general manager if you decided to?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 派遣の私より上司との報が仲良さそうで
dialogue.English: They seem to be on better terms with my supervisor than with a temporary employee like me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 言って取り合ってくれるのか
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if they would take me seriously if I said something,

dialogue.content: ふあんです
dialogue.English: I'm worried about it.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・めぐみさんの不安はごもっともです。
dialogue.English: I see... Your anxiety is completely understandable, Megumi.

dialogue.content: まだ、同僚の正社員に話す方が良いかな、段階として統括にいきなりはなすのは勇気要ります
dialogue.English: Maybe it's better to talk to a full-time coworker first, as a first step. It would take a lot of courage to go straight to the general manager.

dialogue.content: そうですね、めぐみさんのお考えの通り、同僚から、外堀を埋めていくほうが良さそうな気がしますね。
dialogue.English: I agree. Just as you're thinking, it seems like it would be better to start with your colleagues and build a base of support from the outside.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 同僚が言いふらしたりしないか心配です
dialogue.English: I’m worried my coworkers might spread it around.

dialogue.content: 話すのは聞いてくれると思うんですが
dialogue.English: I think they would listen if I talked to them, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 女性同士の話って何かと広がるから
dialogue.English: you know how talk among women tends to spread.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 少しこれまでの話をまとめていいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: ただ「セクハラ発言」やめてほしいだけなのに、大きな問題になりたくない
dialogue.English: I just want him to stop the sexually harassing comments, I don't want this to become a big issue.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これまで約一年もの間、上司のセクハラ発言にめぐみさんは耐え続けてきました、
dialogue.English: For about a year now, you have been enduring your supervisor’s sexually harassing comments.

dialogue.content: できれば上司とシフトを変えたいと思っていますが、今すぐは難しそうです、
dialogue.English: You'd like to be on a different shift from him if possible, but that seems difficult to achieve right now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもこのままでもいけないと思って相談してくれました。
dialogue.English: But you felt that you couldn't let things continue as they are, which is why you came to talk today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: めぐみさんの言葉の中に人と争いたくない、
dialogue.English: From what you've said, I sense that you don't want conflict with people,

dialogue.content: 自分さえ我慢すれば平和に過ごせる、
dialogue.English: that if you just endure it yourself, things can remain peaceful,

dialogue.content: とどこか、自分の感情を抑え込んでしまっているところがあるなと思いました。
dialogue.English: and that because of that, you have a tendency to suppress your own feelings.

dialogue.content: ああ。。。
dialogue.English: Ah...

dialogue.content: そうかもしれないです
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: もっと、めぐみさん自身を大事にしてほしいなと思いました。
dialogue.English: I feel that you should value yourself more, Megumi.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 嫌なことは嫌と言える強さも時には必要なのかなと。
dialogue.English: Sometimes, I think we need the strength to say that we don't like something when we don't like it.

dialogue.content: そのために賛同してくれる同僚を得るのはめぐみさんにとってきっと力になるだろうなと思いました。
dialogue.English: To that end, I think gaining the support of a sympathetic coworker would surely be empowering for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もしも相手がその気がなくてもめぐみさん自身が気持ち悪いと思っているのだから、セクハラには間違いないですしね。
dialogue.English: Even if he doesn't intend it that way, if you yourself feel disgusted by it, then it is undoubtedly sexual harassment.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、そこは間違ってないんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So I'm not wrong about that.

dialogue.content: ええ。めぐみさんは間違っていません。めぐみさんが気持ちよくお仕事できるように
dialogue.English: That's right. You are not wrong, Megumi. So that you can work in comfort,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 職場環境を変えることが大事ですよ。もしかすると、他にも同じように感じている社員さんがいるかも知れません。
dialogue.English: it's important to change your work environment. It's possible that there are other employees who feel the same way you do.

dialogue.content: そうですな、他にもいるかもは思いつかなかったです
dialogue.English: You're right, I hadn't considered that there might be others.

dialogue.content: 同僚に話してみます！
dialogue.English: I'll try talking to a coworker!

dialogue.content: ええ、勇気を出して一歩踏み出されることを応援しています！
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm rooting for you to take that courageous first step!

dialogue.content: やってみます！
dialogue.English: I'll do it!

dialogue.content: めぐみさんの力強い言葉が聞けて嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear you say that with such conviction, Megumi.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 今日は時間が来てしまいましたが、このあたりで終了しても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Our time is up for today. Is it alright if we end here?

dialogue.content: 行動するのは少し勇気がいるかもしれないですけど頑張ってくださいね。もしよかったら取り組んでみてどうだったかなど、また教えて下さいね。
dialogue.English: It might take some courage to take action, but please do your best. If you'd like, please let me know how it goes.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: それでは、めぐみさんのよりよい未来をお祈りしています。
dialogue.English: Well then, I wish you all the best for the future, Megumi.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってみます！
dialogue.English: I'll do my best!

dialogue.content: はい、応援しています！
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m rooting for you!

dialogue.content: （終了いたしますね）
dialogue.English: (I'll end the session now.)

dialogue.content: （終了していいですか？）
dialogue.English: (Is it okay to end here?)
